headline: RapWire 24/7: Five distinct stories — Sept. 26, 2026 — 5 PM Pacific
body: Lil Durk was acquitted on the murder-for-hire counts tied to the Los Angeles shooting while a separate case remains. Remy Ma released the six-song Alimony EP. Yeat released the seven-track COCOON pack with Drake. Sleepy Hallow dropped Loaded, and Plato III released Grown (Deluxe).
caption:
1) Lil Durk was acquitted of the murder-for-hire, conspiracy and stalking counts tied to the 2022 Los Angeles shooting that killed Quando Rondo’s cousin. He remains in custody while a separate racketeering case moves forward, so the verdict is a major win but not the end of his legal fight. @lildurk https://apnews.com/article/3166e39855cee7b3f3d04bdae8498ccf

2) Remy Ma released the six-song Alimony EP, her first project in nine years, alongside the Keke Wyatt-assisted video for “Why I Get Married?” The Bronx veteran says the project is meant to feel like a conversation between women, while its Papoose references place the music inside a very public divorce chapter. @remyma https://www.complex.com/music/a/tracewilliamcowen/remy-ma-alimony-ep

3) Yeat’s seven-track COCOON is out, including “MISS MY DAWG” with Drake and the “EARNËD IT” video. The release extends Yeat’s experimental run while the Drake collaboration gives the pack an immediate mainstream flashpoint. @yeat https://www.universalmusic.ca/2026/09/21/yeat-releases-cocoon/

4) Sleepy Hallow dropped the new single “Loaded” on Sept. 25 with an official video. The release keeps the Brooklyn drill voice active after his return to music this year and gives fans a fresh standalone record rather than a full project announcement. @sleepyhallow https://music.apple.com/us/artist/sleepy-hallow/1266711112

5) Plato III released Grown (Deluxe), expanding the 2025 album with remixes featuring Bartees Strange, ELUCID, Open Mike Eagle and McKinley Dixon. It is a character-rich indie-rap release about work, adulthood and money, built for listeners who want rap with room to think. @platothethird https://www.polyvinylrecords.com/products/plato-iii-grown-deluxe

@Rapwire247
